Highway 11 is the area's north-south road, and its bus route runs from Bourquin Exchange through Matsqui Village on Riverside Road toward Mission City Station.

Houses here are single-detached homes on agricultural and rural lots, and the agricultural zones set the lot floor: the Agricultural One (A1) zone's minimum subdivision size is 8.0 ha and the Agricultural Two (A2) zone's is 16.0 ha.

The housing is freehold farm and rural-residential land, and the City's AgRefresh work records the agricultural pattern as two designations, Agriculture 1 – Uplands on A1 patterns and Agriculture 2 – Lowlands on A2 patterns.
The village's own school-sized anchor is Máthxwi Elementary at 33661 Elizabeth Avenue, which the school's site states serves approximately 150 students and their families.

blocks.text: Matsqui Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A principal residence in the ALR is capped in size, and the Commission states it must have a total floor area of 500 m² or less with no more than 1,000 m² of fill placed for its construction.

A suite in the ALR can only sit inside the principal residence, because the Commission states a secondary suite is permitted in the ALR only when it is entirely contained within the principal residence and local bylaws permit it.

blocks.text: Matsqui Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Matsqui Village Park is the village's park, at 6074 Riverside Road, listed in the City's parks list with a ball diamond, basketball and sports court, tennis court, playground, picnic shelter, washrooms, trails and a parking lot.

Rural water service is capped by bylaw, and the City's Waterworks Regulation Bylaw limits water service connections for properties outside the Urban Development Boundary to a maximum of 25 mm in diameter.

A registered suite is taxed on the annual bill, and the City states registered owners are billed annually for property taxes, solid waste collection, secondary suites and other charges in one billing.

blocks.text: Matsqui Houses: development and new projects

items.t: The Fraser River Bank Erosion Protection project is the major infrastructure work touching Matsqui housing land, and the City states it will stabilize approximately three kilometres of the Fraser River riverbank along the northern boundary of Abbotsford to reduce flood risk for the Matsqui Prairie. Status (as of November 3, 2026): funded and announced, with more than $19 million committed by the governments of Canada and British Columbia with the City of Abbotsford.
Properties in the Matsqui Prairie Dyking, Drainage and Irrigation District pay a district tax rate of 0.71196 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2026, under Tax Rates Bylaw No. 3727-2026.
The district also levies per-acre parcel taxes, set for 2026 at $28.00 per acre in the Matsqui Prairie Dyking Area and $9.33, $32.71 and $35.13 per acre in irrigation Zones 2, 3 and 4.
Route 31 is the prairie's bus link, and its 31A trips stop at Matsqui Village on the run between Bourquin Exchange in Abbotsford and Mission City Station via Highway 11 and the Mission Bridge.

Highway 11 is the road connection north to Mission and south into Abbotsford, and the route 31 timetable's stops read Bourquin Exchange, George Ferguson Way at Montrose Avenue, Matsqui Village, Junction Mall and Mission City Station in that order.
Riverside Road is the village's own street, carrying the route 31A stop and Matsqui Village Park at 6074 Riverside Road.

blocks.text: Matsqui Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the lot's floodproofing area first, because Matsqui Prairie is Area "E" on Schedule "E" of the Zoning Bylaw, with full floodproofing at 9.8 m GSC and reduced provisions only for buildings behind standard dykes.

Check the dyke's condition as part of diligence, because the City states the Matsqui Dike protects the prairie and that bank erosion could create a dike breach, which is the risk the Fraser River Bank Erosion Protection project is funded to reduce.
Confirm ALR status before valuing a second dwelling, because the Commission's one-residence rule and size caps apply on ALR parcels whether or not the listing mentions them.
